substantive_assessment.conclusion: On inequality, null F selects the named fallback operand and decrements int(T+0x34); nonnull F increments that integer only when the compared row pointer was null. substantive_assessment.qualification: This supports source-local pointer storage and forwarding, not an active-processing/refcount meaning or transactional law. The fallback operand has not been read as a file word or followed. The supplied pointer F is not directly called here; the delegated helper may copy, retain, schedule, invoke or otherwise use it, but none of those behaviors is established by this body. Local-operand lifetime and actual dispatch/receiver remain unknown.
